subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel be default-on behavior in the bundled Discord plugin, or should it require opt-in or narrower semantics?
rationale: Current main lacks the feature, but the open PR changes live Discord session/cancellation behavior for existing users, so maintainers need to confirm the product default before landing.

options.title: Accept default-on semantics after proof
options.body: Land the linked PR path once code review and live Discord proof show edits reprocess and deletes cancel only the source message's work.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Ask the implementation to add a narrow Discord config gate or staged rollout before existing users get edit/delete reprocessing behavior.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Split edit reprocessing from delete-to-cancel if maintainers want the safer edit path first and a separate cancellation decision later.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on semantics after proof
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR path once code review and live Discord proof show edits reprocess and deletes cancel only the source message's work.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent history across the Discord monitor/listener files and prior review context for the final semantics.
